startMessage.line1: When a reply is late, why does your chest tighten so fast?
startMessage.line2: You're usually chill — until you're dating, and suddenly you keep checking your phone. A slow reply makes you restless; silence makes the whole day hard to focus. Looking at yourself, you wonder, "What's wrong with me? Am I being clingy?"
startMessage.line3: Behind what looks like obsession, everyone has a different need. Maybe you want reassurance. Maybe anxiety snowballs. Maybe you need to feel in control. Maybe you're blocking loneliness. Or maybe you're terrified of being left. Once you name the need — not just the behavior — change becomes possible.
startMessage.line4: These 10 scenarios show the real reason you cling to contact, and the hidden need underneath.
